name: Quickening Lanceshaft
description: Press the butt into the rest and sit back so rider and lance lock into one line.

name: Slinking Tilt
description: Release the horse from a walk with the heels and build speed along the lance's line.

name: Rugged Shatter
description: Keep the point pinned on one spot of the target through the whole run-in and strike through it.

name: Genial Vamplate
description: Lock the elbow against the ribs so impact shock passes into the body and not the wrist.

name: Stubborn Counterbalance
description: Sweep the point across to the off side to clear a spear thrust from the near shoulder.

name: Coasting Impact
description: Wheel the horse about beyond the pass to face the enemy's line again.

name: Wild Coronel
description: Run a thread of qi into the point so the thrust bores through plate at the moment of impact.

name: Lancehead Buckle
description: Spread a short breath of qi down the shaft to damp the shock when the lance strikes a hard shield.

name: Alert Arrestrest
description: Open the grip and slide the shaft a hand's width forward to shift balance onto the point.

name: Graperslap
description: Raise the grip above the shoulder and jab downward at a foot soldier beside the horse.

name: Padded Bellrest
description: Draw the shaft in across the horse's shoulder to cover its chest from a cut.

name: Tilthurdle
description: Check the horse with a half turn of the wrist to pivot it on the haunches toward a new target.

name: Bold Bowl
description: Let the point trail low behind the flank and whip it up at a pursuing rider's mount.

name: Rigid Couchrest
description: Lift the shield arm across the body while the lance hand keeps the point forward.

name: Vamplinen
description: Fix the gaze on one mark of the foe's armor and hold the point there through three strides.

name: Acrid Momentum
description: Spend qi through the horse's stride to build the charge's weight and release it as one heavy thrust.

name: Shielding Graper
description: Hold the shaft crosswise before the chest with qi in the wood to bar a mounted rush.

name: Impacthasp
description: Slide the point under a rider's lance shaft and lift it out of its rest.

name: Attentive Vamplate
description: Shift the rider's weight over the horse's neck so a heavily armored mount accelerates evenly.

name: Grim Momentum
description: Aim the point at the seam between breastplate and gorget and drive straight through it.

name: Rigid Lanceshaft
description: Throw the thick part of the shaft across to knock a mace head aside.

name: Fleet Impact
description: Pivot the heavy horse through a tight half circle by leaning the rider's weight into the turn.

name: Gagging Shatter
description: Drive the armored shoulder into a foot soldier in passing to knock him off his feet.

name: Lanceguard Thwack
description: Add qi to the downward drop of the point so a thrust through heavy plate buries deeper.

name: Keen Tilt
description: Swing the heavy butt end round after a lance break to strike the nearest foe.

name: Brawngraper
description: Count five slow breaths while lowering the lance to the rest, repeating until the motion is smooth.

name: Impactscorer
description: Come up from below with the point and strike the target's belt line underhand.

name: Brawnride
description: Cut a slant across the horse's front and strike the target on the near side.

name: Grittilt
description: Cross the reins over the neck to check and turn the horse without lifting the lance hand.

name: Graperbuckle
description: Lift the lance's tip sharply to throw back a descending cut before it reaches the arm.

name: Humsaddle
description: Wheel in a drill-yard circle while glancing over the shoulder to judge a pursuer's distance.

name: Fierce Lancehead
description: Pulse qi twice through the couched shaft in two strides so the point lands on the second pulse.

name: Sproutsaddle
description: Re-seat the butt in the rest after a glancing blow with a short surge of qi in the arm.

name: Humbowl
description: Shove the shaft sideways through a crowd with qi in the wood to open a path for the horse.

name: Purpose Counterbalance
description: Plant the butt and cant the point up into a hedge of lances before the riders arrive.

name: Slumber Bowl
description: Flick the point toward a charging horse's eyes to make it veer out of line.

name: Honedimpact
description: Meet the rider's breastplate squarely at the instant he commits to his thrust.

name: Rill Couchrest
description: Roll clear to the side after the point breaks and rise with the shaft held as a short staff.

name: Shard Graper
description: Brace the body behind the planted shaft with qi in the legs to bear a charge without being driven back.

name: Discord Ride
description: Lift a charging horse's forelegs with a rising shove of the shaft so it stumbles.

name: Dawn Coronel
description: Rise slightly out of the saddle so the horse's stride does not jar the aim.

name: Honed Arrestrest
description: Use the lance's full length to strike a rider before his own weapon can come to bear.

name: Humimpact
description: Catch the rim of an enemy shield with the point and pull it away from his body.

name: Candorgraper
description: Hold the line through a cloud of dust by sighting along the shaft to the horse's ears.

name: Brass Vamplate
description: Swing the trailing half of the shaft around and whip it at a pursuer on the off side.

name: Draught Ride
description: Weave the horse through two staggered turns to throw off a pursuer's aim.

name: Brass Bellrest
description: Let a pulse of qi lead the point so the thrust finishes just ahead of the horse's weight.

name: Hum Lancehead
description: Flick the butt back with a snap of qi to knock aside a thrust from a pursuing rider.

name: Recall Lanceguard
description: Align eye, shaft and mark in one straight line and keep the head still through the stride.

name: Counterbalance Slap
description: Plunge the point into the dead center of a target board held by a squire.

name: Staticride
description: Rap the shaft across the front of an enemy rank to disorder their points.

name: Clay Bellrest
description: Back the horse two lengths to keep the point just outside an enemy's reach.

name: Draught Lanceguard
description: Drop the butt beside the stirrup and angle the shaft to block a low sword cut.

name: Dawn Couchrest
description: Ease the rein after a swerve and relevel the point so the line runs straight again.

name: Shard Coronel
description: Drive a surge of qi into the point to pass through the boards of a shield.

name: Brassgraper
description: Turn the shaft back along the near side with qi in the wood to stop a thrust from within the line.

name: Hum Tilt
description: Hook a rider's shield arm and twist the shaft to throw him out of balance.

name: Poise Graper
description: Hold the lance hand slow and still while the rein hand works fast to keep the point level.

name: Grit Bowl
description: Whip the rein hand in a short arc to turn the horse inside an opponent's turn.

name: Tiltscorer
description: Tap the point against a rider's visor as he bends, rattling his aim.

name: Hearty Lanceshaft
description: Lower the lance to the rest as the rein goes loose and the horse surges forward.

name: Humgraper
description: Swing the shaft up in a short arc to parry a sword cut at the rider's forearm.

name: Lassoing Ride
description: Spur the horse suddenly across the foe's path and force a late guard.

name: Static Vamplate
description: Reach across the horse's neck to thrust at a foe on the far side.

name: Sprout Arrestrest
description: Carry a thread of qi along reins and shaft so the horse follows the lance's aim without a rein pull.

name: Staticvamp
description: Beat the foe's shaft twice in quick succession with qi in the point to clear a path to the body.

name: Sturdy Graper
description: Sweep the shaft across the front of the horse with a surge of qi to clear several thrusts at once.
